text_en: I see you are ready to leave.
I must say, I have never seen a fallen army organise itself so well in order to achieve an objective proposed by the Valkyries.
Either way, it is best you do not forget everything that has happened to you, what you have experienced here has been anything but normal.
I hope you can continue on your path without those sort of setbacks.
It's been a pleasure to have hosted you within Hafin's walls, Human army of Zarga. I hope you find what you seek.
